core_principles: Fusion over Imitation: Mix Swiss clarity with Soft Utility approachability.
Emotion First: Trust, Precision, and Calm.
Content is King: Data is the hero. Numbers must be legible.
Negative Space: Use 'p-8' where others use 'p-4'. Breathing room equals luxury.
Contrast: High contrast for data legibility. No gray-on-gray text.
anti_patterns: Gradients on text (Reduces legibility for financial data).
The 'Card' everywhere disease (Use whitespace to separate sections instead).

usage_rules: Use 'Inter' for body text, inputs, and standard UI elements.
Use 'JetBrains Mono' for ALL currency values, transaction IDs, and invoice numbers.
Never center-align headings unless it's the Landing Page Hero.
Primary Color (#4F46E5) is for Main Actions ONLY (Save, Pay, Send).
Secondary Color is for 'Cancel' or 'Back' actions.
Success Color is for 'Paid' status and positive trends.
Destructive Color is for 'Overdue', 'Delete', and negative trends.
Do not use gradients for backgrounds. Use solid colors with subtle borders.

glassmorphism.rules: Use backdrop-blur-md bg-white/70 border border-white/20 for sticky headers and floating panels.

buttons.primary: bg-primary text-primary-foreground hover:bg-primary/90 h-10 px-4 py-2 rounded-md font-medium transition-all shadow-sm hover:shadow-md
buttons.secondary: bg-secondary text-secondary-foreground hover:bg-secondary/80 h-10 px-4 py-2 rounded-md font-medium border border-transparent
buttons.outline: border border-input bg-background hover:bg-accent hover:text-accent-foreground h-10 px-4 py-2 rounded-md font-medium

cards.default: bg-card text-card-foreground rounded-lg border shadow-sm p-6
cards.interactive: bg-card text-card-foreground rounded-lg border shadow-sm p-6 hover:shadow-md hover:border-primary/20 transition-all cursor-pointer
cards.metric: flex flex-col gap-2 p-6 bg-card rounded-lg border shadow-sm

inputs.default: flex h-10 w-full rounded-md border border-input bg-background px-3 py-2 text-sm ring-offset-background file:border-0 file:bg-transparent file:text-sm file:font-medium placeholder:text-muted-foreground focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring focus-visible:ring-offset-2 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50

tables.header: bg-muted/50 text-left text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground uppercase tracking-wider

visual_enhancers.textures: Use subtle noise texture on the dashboard background (opacity 0.02) to reduce digital flatness.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install 'lucide-react' for icons. Use icons for all sidebar items and key actions.
Use 'sonner' for all toast notifications (Success: CheckCircle, Error: AlertTriangle).
For the Salary Slip PDF, use a dedicated print-friendly layout. Hidden on screen, visible on print (@media print).
The Dashboard must have a 'Welcome Back, [Name]' header with the current date.
Use Skeleton loaders (Shadcn Skeleton) for all data fetching states. Never show empty white space.
Ensure the 'Invoice' creation form uses a two-column grid for 'Bill To' and 'Bill From'.
Implement a 'Dark Mode' toggle in the sidebar or header.
Use 'badge' components for status indicators (Paid=Green, Pending=Yellow, Overdue=Red).
DO NOT use standard HTML <table>. Use the Shadcn Table component.
DO NOT use standard HTML <select>. Use Shadcn Select component.
DO NOT use standard HTML <input type='date'>. Use Shadcn Calendar/Popover.
universal_guidelines: You tend to converge toward generic outputs. Avoid this.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients.
Create depth through layered design elements.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
All interactive elements MUST include 'data-testid' attribute (kebab-case).
